sections.subhead: Fixing a Slow WordPress Site From the Inside Out

body.html: WordPress Speed Optimization in Kochi by Teknoppy speeds up slow WordPress sites for Kochi and Kerala businesses. We test first, fix caching, images, plugins, database queries and scripts in order of impact, then re-test with the same tool and deliver a verified before-and-after performance report. Most sites are optimized within 2–4 days.

Businesses across Kochi often discover this problem the same way: a free online speed audit flags slow load times and red scores, but gives no clear path forward. Our speed optimization service turns confusing warnings into real load-time reductions that keep visitors on your site and satisfy Google's ranking criteria.

items.title: WordPress Page Speed Optimization
items.html: Our WordPress page speed optimization Kochi process starts with a full technical audit — hosting response time, database queries, plugin load, theme scripts — before any fix is applied, so changes target the actual bottleneck instead of guesswork.

items.title: Caching Setup
items.html: A properly configured WordPress caching setup service is often the single biggest speed gain available. We set up page, browser, and object caching tuned to your specific host and traffic pattern, rather than a one-size-fits-all plugin default.

items.title: Image Optimization
items.html: Unoptimized images are one of the most common causes of slow load times. Our WordPress image optimization service compresses and correctly formats every image on the site without a visible drop in quality.

items.title: Performance Tuning
items.html: Beyond caching and images, our WordPress performance optimization Kochi work covers database cleanup, script deferral, and removing unused plugin bloat that quietly slows every page down.

sections.h2: Frequently Asked Questions — WordPress Speed Optimization Kochi

items.q: What does WordPress speed optimization include?
items.a: It includes a baseline audit, caching setup (page, browser, object), image compression, database query cleanup, CSS/JS deferral, and removal of render-blocking assets.

items.q: How is this different from Core Web Vitals optimization?
items.a: Core Web Vitals focuses strictly on Google's search ranking signals (LCP, CLS, INP). WordPress speed optimization is the broader engineering work on the WordPress host, database, plugins, and theme that produces fast real-world loading.

items.q: Can you fix a slow WordPress website without a redesign?
items.a: Yes. The vast majority of speed bottlenecks are code, image, and database issues that can be fixed under the hood without altering the look and feel of your website.

items.q: Do you provide before-and-after speed test results?
items.a: Yes. We capture baseline metrics in Google PageSpeed Insights and GTmetrix before making changes, and deliver a comprehensive before-and-after verification report.

items.q: How much does WordPress speed optimization cost in Kochi?
items.a: Basic optimization (caching and image compression) starts at Rs. 15,000. Full performance tuning covering database queries, plugin audits, and script minification typically ranges between Rs. 25,000 and Rs. 45,000.

items.q: How do you handle WordPress mobile speed optimization specifically?
items.a: Mobile devices and cellular networks require special consideration. We optimize mobile viewport assets, implement responsive image sizing (WebP/AVIF), defer non-critical mobile JavaScript, and minimize layout shifts (CLS) on touchscreens.
